name: Nos
source:
Nos is a powerful Elder Dark Lord from an old forgotten era, originally born as an Earth Dragon, Noce was turned into a Dark Lord by Demon King Gele and vowed loyalty to her, which he maintained even after she was defeated and sealed.

[From [url=https://alicesoft.fandom.com/wiki/Noce]AliceSoft Wiki[/url]]
